text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A joint training session was held, hosted 
by the U.A.F. With support from senior 
Trainers, the training progressed 
smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was then revealed that he was Sonon 
Elfie's former trainer. Furthermore, it 
turned out that Ryoka Tsurugi had been a 
fan of hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to cheer with all my might for 
retired Umamusume who find a new place to 
shine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that sentiment shared by so many, Ryoka 
Tsurugi found a hint for promoting the 
U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With burning passion in her heart, Ryoka 
Tsurugi sets out to plan a brand-new PR 
campaign.
